newsitem.title: USA: USDA buys 2.53 mln lbs frozen pork for programs.
newsitem.headline: USDA buys 2.53 mln lbs frozen pork for programs.

text.p: The Agricultural Marketing Service of the U.S. Department of Agriculture said it bought approximately 2.53 million lbs of pork products for use in the National School Lunch Program and other Federal programs.
The latest award under Announcement LS-50, Invitation 23 and 24 will be shipped between January 5 and 18, 1997.
Details of the purchase are as follows:
Total purchases since the program was announced:
Winning bidders for the pork sausage patties were Bauer Meat Co (Ocala, FL) 39,600 lbs and Cherry Meat Packers Inc (Chicago IL) 118,800 lbs.
Winning bidders for fine ground pork were Barrios Distributing (Ocala Fl) 79,200 lbs, Bo Packing Co (Chicago IL) 792,000 lbs and IBP Inc (Storm Lake and Columbus Jn, Iowa) 277,200 lbs.

Winning bidders for frozen hams were American Foods Group (Mitchell SD) 288,000 lbs, Excel Corp (Fort Branch IN) 288,000 lbs, Farmland Foods Inc (Crete NE) 540,000 lbs, John Morrell and Co (Great Bend KS) 108,000 lbs.
